Both assistants provide correct solutions with O(m+n) time complexity as requested. However, Assistant A is superior because it uses O(1) extra space (avoiding the full merge) and can terminate early once the kth element is found (O(k) in the best case), whereas Assistant B always merges all m+n elements into a new list (O(m+n) space and strictly O(m+n) time). Assistant A also handles out-of-bounds k values more gracefully by returning `None` instead of raising an `IndexError` or returning incorrect results via negative indexing.

[[A]]
